name: Mystery
overview: Scripture reveals that certain truths, described as mysteries, were once hidden but have now been disclosed by God according to His sovereign will and purpose. While some secret things belong solely to the Lord, He graciously grants understanding of the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven to His people, as shown in the teachings of Jesus. These mysteries, which were kept secret since the world began, are now made known through the gospel and the revelation of Christ, demonstrating God's power to establish and guide believers. Thus, the study of mystery in the Bible highlights both God's wisdom in concealing and revealing His divine plan for salvation.
